title: Power Rankings: Lakers leap into No. 1 spot
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 17
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: If our new BFFs from The Onion thought it was gutsy a few weeks back when we moved the Lakers from No. 4 to No. 3, what will they say when they see our mea culpa promotion of Kobe and Co. from No. 5 to No. 1?

rankings.summaryHtml: The Rockets are two home W's away from a perfect February. And I'm sure they'll apologize for the fact that they've faced only four winning teams in an 11-0 month as soon as they get higher than seventh in the West.

rankings.summaryHtml: Two big gulps for the Big Cactus: Shaq had never lost his debut with an NBA team before Kobe's Lakers became just the second team ever to score 30 points or more in every quarter against one of Shaq's teams.
